sources.author: De-Vanced
patch_list: Adds a button that triggers the same action as shaking your phone would.
Adds an "Export GPX" item to the activity overflow menu, which saves the activity's GPS track as a GPX file in Downloads/Strava.
Extends the full-screen media viewer menu with items to copy or open their URLs or download them directly.
Allows exporting and downloading Strava routes as GPX or TCX files directly from the app.
Blocks Snowplow analytics. See https://snowplow.io for more information.
Prevents the Quick Edit prompt from popping up.
Re-enables password login after having used an OTP code.
Hides elements that are not essential.
Overwrites the compression, resize and trim media (images and videos) parameters returned by Strava's server before upload.
